topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Well, I heard the news about the old house up the lane, passed down to the young ones, the sister and brother. A fine old place it was, with more stories in its stones than a scribe's book. The last I saw of them, they were just little ones running through the fields, chasing the hens and pulling up the roots of the meadow flowers. Now they're grown, and they have a weighty task ahead, sorting out what’s what and how to make that old house serve them. I reckon it’s a blessing and a burden, all at once. The fields need plowing soon, and I've not the time to dwell, but I’ll be thinking on them as they take up their new roles. Hope the saints guide their hands and clear their path.
